upgrade.notice.title: Your wallet has been upgraded
upgrade.notice.body: We've upgraded this wallet's protection on this device. Nothing changes for you: keep using the same PIN. For 7 days we also keep a copy in the previous format, in case you need to go back to an older version of the app. After that it is removed automatically, and only the new protection remains.
create.credential.choose: Choose how to protect your wallet
create.passphrase.title: Set Your Passphrase
create.passphrase.recommended: Want extra protection? A passphrase is a good choice, especially if you plan to hold a larger amount.
create.passphrase.explain: Choose a passphrase of at least 12 characters, such as several unrelated words. It gives this wallet stronger protection on this device than a PIN.
create.passphrase.unrecoverable: Nobody can reset a forgotten passphrase, including us. If you forget it, you can only get back in with your recovery phrase, so keep that safe.
create.passphrase.label: Passphrase
create.passphrase.mismatch: The two passphrases don't match. Try again.
passphrase.reject.too_short: Too short. Use at least 12 characters, for example several unrelated words.
passphrase.reject.too_long: Too long. Use at most 256 characters.
passphrase.reject.common: Not accepted: this is a very common passphrase. Choose something only you would think of.
passphrase.reject.repeated: Not accepted: it just repeats the same characters. Mix in different words.
passphrase.reject.sequential: Not accepted: it is a simple sequence like abcdef or 123456. Choose something less predictable.
protection.title: Wallet protection
protection.nudge: Your PIN protects your wallet on this device. For extra peace of mind, you can switch to a passphrase: a few words of your choosing for even stronger protection.
protection.done: Protection updated. Use the new PIN or passphrase from now on.
protection.wrong_current: That is not the current PIN or passphrase.
protection.pin_invalid: A PIN must be exactly 6 digits.
protection.failed: Could not change the protection. Nothing was changed.
biometric.upgrade.title: Strengthen biometric unlock
biometric.upgrade.body: We can now tie biometric unlock more closely to your device's own security. You'll be asked to confirm with your fingerprint or face once, and unlocking works the same afterwards.
biometric.upgrade.failed: Couldn't upgrade right now. Nothing was changed, and biometric unlock keeps working as before.
biometric.weak.title: About biometric unlock here
biometric.weak.body: On this browser, biometric unlock is a convenience: it makes unlocking quicker, but it slightly lowers protection for your wallet's saved data compared with using only your PIN or passphrase. You can turn it off any time in Settings.
legacy.title: This device can't use the stronger protection
legacy.reason_browser: This browser doesn't support what the stronger wallet protection needs.
legacy.reason_memory: This device doesn't have enough free memory for the stronger wallet protection right now.
legacy.body: Your wallet can still be created, but with the earlier, lighter protection. It will upgrade by itself the first time you unlock it on a device or browser that supports the stronger one.
legacy.agree: Create it with the earlier protection

home.info.format.hd.hint: Uses modern SegWit addresses starting with dgb1. These are more efficient and have lower fees than older Legacy addresses starting with D.
home.info.network.hint: Mainnet is the real DigiByte network where DGB has actual value. Testnet is for developers to test without real money.
